contradiction.claim: On the Terrace from about 20:30 to 20:50; never went near the Gallery after dinner.

explanation: Victor entered the Gallery at 20:36, cut the canvas from its stretcher (clue 2), hid it in the Terrace planter at 20:44 (clue 3), and returned to the Dining Room at 20:52. Motive: Eleanor refused to sell him the painting. Sophie's sketchbook (clue 1) is a red herring; the log keeps her in the Study.
